subject.title: fix: bound gateway model pricing cache

question: Should gateway pricing refreshes prioritize previously accessed cached models over newly discovered catalog models when the bounded cache must evict entries?
rationale: The PR states that recent lookups should survive refreshes, but the fixed 4096-entry policy necessarily chooses between active historical entries and newly fetched catalog rows; that retention contract is not settled by tests alone.

options.title: Prioritize accessed cache rows
options.body: Treat existing Map recency as authoritative, retain recently used rows across full-new over-limit refreshes, and cap unseen catalog rows first.

options.title: Prioritize refresh catalog rows
options.body: Keep source-refresh-order retention and document that a catalog refresh may evict every previously used model price.

recommendation.title: Prioritize accessed cache rows
recommendation.body: Treat existing Map recency as authoritative, retain recently used rows across full-new over-limit refreshes, and cap unseen catalog rows first.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history places this contributor closest to the gateway model-pricing behavior and prior cache-bound discussion.
